title: Travis Walton case fire-tower debunk disputed

tellings.quote: And there and they talk about this fire tower and it's like it was right next to the road. It's like, no, it's not. It's over a hill.

plain: A popular debunking of the 1975 Travis Walton case, in which an Arizona man said he was taken by a UFO, holds that the light his companions saw was a fire tower beside the road. The writer and researcher Greg Bishop tells Michels this is wrong on the ground: the tower is not right next to the road, he says, "it's over a hill." If he is right, the easy explanation for what the men saw falls away.
